name: Noah Valentine
bio: Noah Marcus Valentine is an English actor.

credits.title: The Boot Room
credits.overview: A junior footballer navigates the brutal hierarchy of a 1988 professional football club steeped in a culture of systemic bullying . His growing unease culminates in a hesitant act of defiance sparking a brutal backlash, turning the violence directly onto him.
